collectible_summary.red_1_star_rule: all other red collectibles are 1 star

optimizer_policy: Spend aggressively when it creates real DPS progress. Gems are not the main factor. Do not treat tech core choice chests as Lightning/Soccer/Laser directly; they are core-type selector value.

recommendations.title: SS forge/core spending
recommendations.spend: core choice x6, tech core choice x40, relic chest x2, relic cores x45
recommendations.advice: Use these on the low SS slots because Belt/Boots/Chest are only 1E/0V/0C.

recommendations.title: Low SS slots
recommendations.spend: Eternal/Void/Chaos cores plus S packs only if needed
recommendations.where: Belt first, then Boots, then Chest
recommendations.advice: Close the forge gap before spending on weaker side paths.

recommendations.title: Xeno pet
recommendations.spend: xeno pet crystal x830 and xeno elixir x1
recommendations.advice: Do not spread Xeno resources across 1-star pets.

recommendations.title: Collectibles
recommendations.where: Custom Collection Set 1 first, then sets 2/3/4 only for set completion
recommendations.advice: Spend around set bonuses, not random loose stars.

recommendations.title: Hold
recommendations.where: S packs, Voidwalker crate, awakening crystals unless they finish a star
recommendations.advice: Keep flexible stuff unless it completes one of the top targets.
